newsitem.title: USA: Burglar caught by footprints in snow.
newsitem.headline: Burglar caught by footprints in snow.

text.p: An ex-convict who allegedly stole office equipment not only left a trail of footprints in the snow but walked into a restaurant filled with police officers, police said on Thursday.

Saratoga Springs Police Officer Gregory Santos discovered the burglary at an insurance company office on Sunday night, tracked the footprints into the woods behind the building and found a coat, hat and tape recorders lying in the snow.
The trail then took him to the door of a restaurant where hundreds of local and state police officers were attending a retirement party for a New York State Police Sergeant.

"He tracked him down like a Mountie" police spokesman Robert Flanagan said. "When Santos came into the party he asked whether anyone had come in without a coat and about 12 officers pointed to a man using a payphone.
"Santos tapped him on the shoulder and arrested him."
The suspect, Jude Clairmont, is being held without bail on third degree burglary charges in Saratoga County jail and will appear in court next week.
